title: Rizlona
summary: Defeating Rizlona's first form reveals her dragon form.
overview: Defeating Rizlona's first form reveals her dragon form.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the raid ready for an immediate second target when the first form falls.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The first form's death spawns the second form immediately at the same position.
Both forms enforce a room boundary; pulling the first form south of the room heals and resets it.
The dragon form has an out-of-combat despawn timer and provides the final progression projection.

notes: Approval E306. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The first-form NPC ID needs a database lookup before linking both forms.
